title: Autonomous quantum heat engine
summary: Quantum heat engines provide attractive means in quantum thermodynamics for studying the fundamentals of the flow of heat and work. Previous experimental implementations of heat engines operating at the level of a few excitation quanta have utilized external driving, which has made the observation of the produced work challenging. Conversely, autonomous quantum heat engines only require a flow of heat to operate and generate work.
